starterPrompts.text: 나에게 배정된 Linear 이슈를 우선순위 순서로 보여 줘요.
진행 중인 프로젝트를 한눈에 정리해 줘요.
내 Linear 알림을 최근 순서로 보여 줘요.

id.description: Issue attachment ID from get_issue's attachments array (attachments[].id)

format.description: Omit or use content to fetch a Linear-hosted file. Use url for attachment metadata without fetching the file; also supports external links

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return per page

cursor.description: Omit for the first page. To continue, pass the previous response's cursor when hasNextPage is true

orderBy.description: Timestamp to sort results by: creation time or last update time

issueId.description: Issue ID or identifier (e.g., LIN-123). P-prefixed identifiers (e.g., P-ENG-123) are projects, not issues (provide exactly one parent)

projectId.description: Project name, ID, identifier (e.g., P-ENG-123), or slug (provide exactly one parent)

initiativeId.description: Initiative name, ID, identifier (e.g., I-123), or slug (provide exactly one parent)

documentId.description: Document ID or slug (provide exactly one parent)

milestoneId.description: Milestone UUID (provide exactly one parent). Resolve milestone names via `list_milestones` first.

statusUpdateId.description: Status update UUID (provide exactly one parent). Resolve status updates via `get_status_updates` first.

statusUpdateType.description: Type of status update named by `statusUpdateId`, as returned by `get_status_updates`. Only valid together with `statusUpdateId`; omit to check both project and initiative status updates.

teamId.description: Team UUID from list_teams or get_team; names and keys are not accepted

type.description: Filter relative to the team's current cycle. Omit to return cycles without this filter

id.description: Update ID from get_status_updates results (statusUpdates[].id) or save_status_update's id

project.description: Project name, ID, identifier (e.g., P-ENG-123), or slug. Filters project updates only; omit to include all accessible projects

initiative.description: Initiative name, ID, identifier (e.g., I-123), or slug. Filters initiative updates only; omit to include all accessible initiatives

user.description: Filter by update author: User ID, name, email, or "me". Omit to include all authors

read.description: Whether the notification should be marked as read

snoozedUntilAt.description: ISO-8601 time to snooze until, or null to unsnooze

id.description: Comment ID. If provided, updates the existing comment

issueId.description: Issue ID or identifier (e.g., LIN-123). P-prefixed identifiers (e.g., P-ENG-123) are projects, not issues (provide exactly one parent)

milestoneId.description: Milestone UUID (provide exactly one parent). Resolve milestone names via `list_milestones` first.

statusUpdateType.description: Type of status update named by `statusUpdateId`, as returned by `get_status_updates`. Only valid together with `statusUpdateId`; omit to check both project and initiative status updates.

parentId.description: Parent comment ID (for replies, only when creating)

body.description: Content as Markdown. Do not escape the string — use literal newlines and special characters, not escape sequences. To mention a user, use @displayName (e.g., @johndoe)

id.description: Only for updating an existing issue. Pass the issue ID or identifier (e.g., LIN-123). Do NOT pass this parameter when creating a new issue.

title.description: Issue title (required when creating, unless template is set)

description.description: Content as Markdown. Do not escape the string — use literal newlines and special characters, not escape sequences. To mention a user, use @displayName (e.g., @johndoe)

patch.description: Partial edits applied to the current content, in order and atomically (one failing operation aborts the whole save). Every anchor string must match the current content exactly once. Only valid on update, in place of the full content/description field

old_string.description: Exact text to replace. Must match the current content exactly once

new_string.description: Replacement text. Empty string deletes the match

replace_all.description: Replace every occurrence instead of requiring a unique match

team.description: Team name or ID (required when creating)

template.description: Template name or ID. Applied on create only. The template fills in the content, fields, and sub-issues server-side. A `description` replaces the template body rather than merging with it, but an empty `description` keeps the template body. Labels merge with the template's own

cycle.description: Cycle name, number, or ID. Null to remove

project.description: Project name, ID, identifier (e.g., P-ENG-123), or slug. Null to remove

assignee.description: User ID, name, email, or "me". Null to remove

delegate.description: Agent name or ID. When the user asks to delegate to "Linear" or "the Linear agent", this refers to the "Linear" app user specifically. Null to remove

labels.description: Label names or IDs as a JSON array of strings (e.g. ["Bug", "Urgent"]). Replaces the full label set; existing labels not included are removed. Omit to leave labels unchanged. Cannot be combined with addLabels/removeLabels; prefer those for incremental changes

addLabels.description: Label names or IDs as a JSON array of strings (e.g. ["Bug", "Urgent"]) to add. Append-only; existing labels are never removed. Cannot be combined with a team change

removeLabels.description: Label names or IDs as a JSON array of strings (e.g. ["Bug", "Urgent"]) to remove. Only valid when updating an existing issue. Cannot be combined with a team change

dueDate.description: Due date (ISO format). On update, pass null to remove the due date

slaBreachesAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the SLA will breach. On update, pass null to remove the SLA

slaType.description: SLA day counting type: "all" or "onlyBusinessDays". Only use with slaBreachesAt; null means unset

parentId.description: Parent issue ID or identifier (e.g., LIN-123). Null to remove

estimate.description: Issue estimate value. On create, pass null or omit for no estimate. On update, pass null to clear the estimate; omitting leaves it unchanged. 0 is a real estimate only on teams that allow zero estimates.

links.description: Link attachments to add [{url, title}]. Append-only; existing links are never removed

setReleases.description: Replace all releases on the issue with these. Cannot be combined with addReleases/removeReleases

addReleases.description: Release IDs or slugs to add. Append-only; existing releases are never removed

removeReleases.description: Release IDs or slugs to remove. Only valid when updating an existing issue

blocks.description: Issue IDs/identifiers this blocks. Append-only; existing relations are never removed

blockedBy.description: Issue IDs/identifiers blocking this. Append-only; existing relations are never removed

relatedTo.description: Related issue IDs/identifiers. Append-only; existing relations are never removed

duplicateOf.description: Duplicate of issue ID/identifier. Null to remove

removeBlockedBy.description: Issue IDs/identifiers to remove as blockers of this issue

id.description: Project name, ID, identifier (e.g., P-ENG-123), or slug. If provided, updates the existing project

template.description: Template name or ID. Applied on create only. The template fills in the content, fields, and sub-issues server-side. A `description` replaces the template body rather than merging with it, but an empty `description` keeps the template body. Labels merge with the template's own

icon.description: Icon name or emoji code (e.g. "Rocket" or ":eagle:"), not a raw Unicode emoji

description.description: Content as Markdown. Do not escape the string — use literal newlines and special characters, not escape sequences. To mention a user, use @displayName (e.g., @johndoe)

patch.description: Partial edits applied to the current content, in order and atomically (one failing operation aborts the whole save). Every anchor string must match the current content exactly once. Only valid on update, in place of the full content/description field

old_string.description: Exact text to replace. Must match the current content exactly once

new_string.description: Replacement text. Empty string deletes the match

replace_all.description: Replace every occurrence instead of requiring a unique match

state.description: Project status name, type, or ID. Names resolve within the lead team's project statuses. If the lead team is unknown, standard labels resolve as status types; custom names require a status ID or leadTeam

startDate.description: Start date (ISO format). Pair with startDateResolution to indicate precision (e.g. month, quarter). Null to remove

startDateResolution.description: Start date resolution. Null for an exact day. When omitted, the current resolution stays and the date snaps to it

targetDate.description: Target date (ISO format). Pair with targetDateResolution to indicate precision (e.g. month, quarter). Null to remove

targetDateResolution.description: Target date resolution. Null for an exact day. When omitted, the current resolution stays and the date snaps to it

addTeams.description: Team name or ID to add

removeTeams.description: Team name or ID to remove

setTeams.description: Replace all teams with these. Cannot combine with addTeams/removeTeams

leadTeam.description: Team that leads the project. Team name or ID. Overrides the default lead team; added to the project's teams when not among them

labels.description: Label names or IDs as a JSON array of strings (e.g. ["Bug", "Urgent"]). Replaces the full label set; existing labels not included are removed. Omit to leave labels unchanged

lead.description: User ID, name, email, or "me". Null to remove, except on create with a template that names a lead

addInitiatives.description: Initiatives to add. Initiative name, ID, identifier (e.g., I-123), or slug

removeInitiatives.description: Initiatives to remove. Initiative name, ID, identifier (e.g., I-123), or slug

setInitiatives.description: Replace all initiatives with these. Initiative name, ID, identifier (e.g., I-123), or slug. Cannot combine with addInitiatives/removeInitiatives

links.description: External resource links to add [{url, title}]. Append-only; existing links are never removed

id.description: Document ID or slug to update. Omit to create a new document.

content.description: Content as Markdown. Do not escape the string — use literal newlines and special characters, not escape sequences. To mention a user, use @displayName (e.g., @johndoe)

patch.description: Partial edits applied to the current content, in order and atomically (one failing operation aborts the whole save). Every anchor string must match the current content exactly once. Only valid on update, in place of the full content/description field

old_string.description: Exact text to replace. Must match the current content exactly once

new_string.description: Replacement text. Empty string deletes the match

replace_all.description: Replace every occurrence instead of requiring a unique match

project.description: Project name, ID, identifier (e.g., P-ENG-123), or slug

issue.description: Issue ID or identifier (e.g., LIN-123). P-prefixed identifiers (e.g., P-ENG-123) are projects, not issues

initiative.description: Initiative name, ID, identifier (e.g., I-123), or slug

cycle.description: Cycle name, number, or ID. When passing a name or number, also pass `team` to disambiguate.

team.description: Team name or ID. Attaches the document to the team, unless `cycle` is also passed, in which case it disambiguates the cycle.

icon.description: Icon name or emoji code (e.g. "Rocket" or ":eagle:"), not a raw Unicode emoji

project.description: Project name, ID, identifier (e.g., P-ENG-123), or slug

targetDate.description: Target completion date (ISO format, null to remove)

id.description: Update ID from get_status_updates results (statusUpdates[].id) or save_status_update's id. Omit to create

project.description: Project name, ID, identifier (e.g., P-ENG-123), or slug

initiative.description: Initiative name, ID, identifier (e.g., I-123), or slug

body.description: Content as Markdown. Do not escape the string — use literal newlines and special characters, not escape sequences. To mention a user, use @displayName (e.g., @johndoe). Required on create; replaces the body on update. Omit on update to leave the body unchanged

isDiffHidden.description: Deprecated. Hide diff with previous update (create only)
